description: Get quick answers to frequently asked questions about appointments, diabetes treatment, doctors, facilities, and patient care at Silver Touch Hospital.

faqs.q: Which is the best diabetes hospital in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a:
Although we cannot say that we are the best, we are certainly striving every single day to be one of the very best diabetes hospitals in Ahmedabad. Overall, Silver Touch Hospitals is a complete multi-speciality center for people with diabetes.
Our treatment consists of expert doctors who take care of your sugar levels, as well as your complications, and coordinate care with specialists, such as Nephrologists (kidney problems), as well as Cardiologists. We offer a comprehensive range of in-house blood investigations and diagnostics to monitor your condition closely. If you are searching for a complete solution in Nirnay Nagar, or even in Satellite, feel free to contact Silver Touch Hospitals.

faqs.q: When should you go to the emergency hospital?
faqs.a:
If you experience severe symptoms like difficulty breathing, sudden chest pain, severe bleeding, unresponsiveness, or signs of a stroke (slurred speech or sudden weakness), you should immediately go to the emergency hospital.
At Silver Touch Hospitals, our critical care department and 24X7 emergency service are fully equipped to manage urgent medical crises, including trauma and serious road accidents. We understand that prompt treatment is critical, and our team is prepared to respond instantly.
So, if you are experiencing any of the symptoms mentioned or you are feeling extremely uneasy in the middle of the night or wee hours, do not hesitate to come to Silver Touch Hospitals for a check-up.

faqs.q: Which is the best knee and hip replacement hospital in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a: Silver Touch Hospitals is one of the most highly regarded hospitals for knee and hip replacement surgery in Ahmedabad. Our team of experts conducts both Total Knee Replacement (TKR) and Total Hip Replacement (THR), including advanced procedures like Robotic-Assisted Surgery for superior precision and faster recovery. We believe in comprehensive care from pre-surgical planning to post-operative guidance on physiotherapy within our modern facility in our branches in Nirnay Nagar and Satellite in Ahmedabad. We always focus on successful outcomes of restored mobility and quality of life.

faqs.q: What is the age limit for hip replacement?
faqs.a: There is no age constraint on hip replacement surgery. It entirely depends on your overall health, activity level, and intensity of your pain. Patients from the age of 70, 80, even 90, have successfully completed hip replacement at Silver Touch Hospitals. Our team of doctors analyses your heart condition and overall health with in-house facilities, such as ECG, blood tests, etc., to check your overall aptness for surgery.

faqs.q: Which hospital is best for liver treatment in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a:
For concerns regarding the liver, you should choose a hospital with a strong Gastroenterology and GI surgery department, such as Silver Touch Hospitals. At both our branches in Nirnay Nagar and Satellite, we have qualified specialists managing a wide range of liver conditions, including fatty liver disease and chronic hepatitis.
By utilising in-house diagnostics like advanced blood tests and ultrasound, our specialists accurately diagnose and monitor the conditions of patients with liver problems. Thanks to our multi-disciplinary approach, you can rest easy knowing you will be receiving comprehensive medical and surgical management.

faqs.q: Which hospital is best for lungs treatment in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a:
If you are experiencing lungs and respiratory issues, come to Silver Touch Hospitals. We are one of the highly trusted hospitals in Ahmedabad for lungs treatment because we have a robust Pulmology department, which is backed by our critical care unit. Our Pulmonology department is run by certified and experienced specialists who manage conditions like COPD, asthma, pneumonia, and breathing disorders. Through the use of tools like chest X-rays and other specialised diagnostics, we accurately assess lung function and offer tailored treatment plans.
Whether you require routine respiratory care or treatment for severe lung problems, Silver Touch Hospitals is fully equipped to offer you the treatment you need.

faqs.q: Which hospital is the best for gastroenterology in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a: Silver Touch Hospitals is the best for gastroenterology in Ahmedabad because our highly skilled and experienced doctors are experts in diagnosing and treating a wide range of stomach, digestive, and intestinal issues. You can count on us for complete care, from managing common concerns like chronic acidity and stomach pain to performing advanced GI surgeries. We also have in-house laboratory and ultrasound facilities that support accurate and rapid diagnosis, ensuring you get the right treatment plan quickly.

faqs.q: Where can I find the best ENT doctor in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a: You can find the best ENT doctor in Ahmedabad at Silver Touch Hospitals, where we provide comprehensive care for common ear, nose, and throat conditions. Our ENT specialists manage everything from sinus problems and throat infections to routine ENT surgeries, supported by in-house diagnostics such as blood investigations and radiology services. With a multispecialty setup and coordinated care, patients receive accurate diagnosis and timely treatment. Silver Touch Hospitals operates at Nirnay Nagar and Satellite, making expert ENT care accessible across Ahmedabad.

faqs.q: Which is the best hospital for knee replacement in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a:
We pride ourselves on being a leading choice for knee replacement. Silver Touch Hospitals provides advanced Total Knee Replacement (TKR), including minimally invasive techniques and, where suitable, Robotic-Assisted Surgery.
Our Orthopedics team prioritises precision implant placement for better longevity and faster recovery. Our comprehensive post-operative care, including guided rehabilitation, ensures we help you achieve the best possible outcome to resume an active, pain-free life.
